context: Extract the team schema and pure registry/CLI operations from PR 6 behind one migration. Define status separately from terminal outcome and use qualified tokens such as agent_kind. Decision gate: stop if the model requires runtime-specific Herdr or Git columns, additive aliases, or more than one canonical spelling for any operation.
description: Add the minimum durable model for teams, managers, tasks, memberships, and lifecycle status. Preserve the useful organization semantics from PR 6 while excluding Herdr provisioning, Git worktree operations, claims, reviewer policy, automatic cleanup, reporting aggregation, and executor-selection policy.

anti_patterns.dont: Add runtime handles directly to team core tables
anti_patterns.instead: Link runtime resources through the owned-resource ledger
anti_patterns.why: It couples organization to one backing system

anti_patterns.dont: Cherry-pick all of tests/test_parallel_teams.py into this PR
anti_patterns.instead: Extract only hierarchy tests into focused test modules
anti_patterns.why: That test file mixes several later feature domains

anti_patterns.dont: Keep an old spelling beside a new spelling
anti_patterns.instead: Choose one spelling and test every user-facing invocation
anti_patterns.why: Bossmode naming policy requires retirement in the same change

preserves.behavior: Each CLI and JSON concept has one canonical qualified spelling.
Existing non-team task and run workflows continue to work.
Status records where an object currently sits; outcome records how a finished object ended.
Team hierarchy remains usable without Herdr or a linked worktree.
